lessons.title: Staff home
lessons.overview: The staff interface brings library work together. Available modules depend on the staff account and enabled features.
steps: Sign in with your own staff account and check the library you are working at.
Identify the module for the task: Circulation, Patrons, Cataloging, Authorities or Reports.
Use the module navigation to continue; this training environment does not sign in to a real Koha instance.

fields.label: Training task
fields.hint: Choose the circulation workflow for lending an item.

lessons.result: Continue with Checkouts to practise the circulation workflow.
lessons.warning: Use an individual account. Seeing a module does not grant permission to perform every action in it.

lessons.title: Add a patron
lessons.overview: A patron record connects identity, library membership and circulation. Required fields depend on local configuration.
steps: Open the patron entry form and choose the appropriate patron category.
Enter identity and membership information; check whether the person already has a record.
Review the form before saving. In real Koha, resolve mandatory-field and duplicate warnings.

fields.label: Surname
fields.hint: Synthetic family name.

fields.label: First name
fields.hint: Synthetic first name.

fields.label: Card number
fields.hint: Unique training card number.

lessons.result: The training patron Alex Reader has card number DEMO-1001. No real patron was created.
lessons.warning: Do not use real personal data in this public manual. Library, category, dates and other requirements vary by site.

lessons.title: Checkouts
lessons.overview: Find the correct patron, scan an item barcode and inspect the resulting loan and due date.
steps: Find the patron and confirm identity before scanning a book.
Enter the item barcode in the checkout form. Read any warning instead of overriding it automatically.
Check the resulting loan and due date; local circulation rules determine whether lending is allowed.

fields.label: Card number
fields.hint: Alex Reader, our synthetic patron.

fields.label: Item barcode
fields.hint: Training copy of The Example Library.

lessons.result: DEMO-2001 is shown as checked out to Alex Reader in this exercise. The manual does not calculate real loan rules.
lessons.warning: Blocks, existing loans, holds and permissions can change the real workflow. Due dates shown by your Koha take precedence.

lessons.title: Checkins
lessons.overview: Checking an item in ends a loan and may trigger a hold or transfer instruction.
steps: Open Checkins and scan the physical item barcode.
Read the response: verify the returned item and any hold or transfer message.
Follow the displayed routing instruction and check the item status before shelving.

fields.label: Item barcode
fields.hint: Use the same training copy as the checkout lesson.

lessons.result: The training loan is returned. A real return can require additional confirmation or routing.
lessons.warning: Do not ignore a hold or transfer message. Return dates and fine calculations follow the installation settings.

lessons.title: Search the catalog
lessons.overview: Catalog results lead to bibliographic details and the physical items attached to each record.
steps: Search for a title, author or identifier using the catalog search.
Inspect the results and select the matching bibliographic record.
Check item availability and location on the record before taking a circulation action.

fields.label: Search terms
fields.hint: Synthetic book used throughout the manual.

lessons.result: Example result: The Example Library — Example Author. Copy DEMO-2001 belongs to the training library.
lessons.warning: An available bibliographic record is not proof that a physical copy is on the shelf. Filters and search engines vary.

lessons.title: Add a bibliographic record
lessons.overview: The MARC editor describes a bibliographic resource using the selected framework.
steps: Choose the appropriate bibliographic framework before entering the record.
In a MARC21 framework, review the title and responsibility fields and complete mandatory fields.
Validate the record and inspect duplicate warnings before saving; add physical items separately.

fields.label: Training title
fields.hint: A synthetic title for a MARC21 cataloging exercise.

fields.label: Training author
fields.hint: A synthetic statement of responsibility.

lessons.result: The bibliographic description is ready for review. A physical copy is added in the Items exercise.
lessons.warning: These training fields summarize a MARC21 exercise, not a complete MARC editor. Framework labels and mandatory tags are configured locally.

lessons.title: Add an item
lessons.overview: An item is a physical copy attached to a bibliographic record. Item fields are generated from the framework.
steps: Open the correct bibliographic record and its item entry screen.
Enter the copy details, including its unique barcode and locally valid library and item type.
Review the physical copy and choose Add item only when its details are correct.

fields.label: Training barcode
fields.hint: Unique synthetic barcode.

fields.label: Training library
fields.hint: Example code only; use a valid local code in real Koha.

lessons.result: One training item is attached to The Example Library. No additional bibliographic record is needed for an identical copy.
lessons.warning: Item field labels depend on the framework. Never reuse a barcode already assigned to another copy.

lessons.title: Place a hold
lessons.overview: A hold records a request for a resource, subject to patron eligibility and local circulation rules.
steps: Open the intended bibliographic record and choose Place hold.
Find the correct patron and review pickup library and eligible items.
Read restrictions and confirm the request only when the patron and resource are correct.

fields.label: Card number
fields.hint: Training patron.

fields.label: Training pickup library
fields.hint: Example pickup location.

lessons.result: A training hold is ready for the example patron and pickup library.
lessons.warning: Priority, eligibility, pickup choices and title-level versus item-level holds depend on local rules.

lessons.title: Search authorities
lessons.overview: Authority records control names and subjects. Similar names may refer to different people or entities.
steps: Open Authorities and select a suitable authority type or search index.
Search a heading and examine the matching records.
Review the preferred heading, variants and identifiers before using a match in cataloging.

fields.label: Training heading
fields.hint: Synthetic heading, not an authority from a real institution.

lessons.result: Example Author is selected for inspection. A match must be reviewed before linking it to bibliographic records.
lessons.warning: This exercise does not merge authorities or verify real identities. Do not link records based only on a similar name.

lessons.title: Saved reports
lessons.overview: Saved reports let authorized staff run reusable queries and inspect their results.
steps: Open Reports and locate the saved report you need.
Read its purpose and SQL or parameters before running it.
Inspect the output and export only what you are authorized to handle.

fields.label: Training report
fields.hint: A fixed, synthetic report; SQL entered here is never executed.

lessons.result: Example result: 3 training items. This fixed sample is not a query against a library database.
lessons.warning: Reports may expose personal data or be expensive to run. Permissions apply; this manual never executes SQL.

lessons.title: Find a vendor
lessons.overview: Acquisitions tracks purchasing. Vendors, budgets and permissions must be prepared before ordering.
steps: Open Acquisitions and check the available budgets and funds.
Use the Vendor search to find the intended supplier.
Inspect the vendor before continuing to baskets and orders; review fund and currency choices.

fields.label: Vendor
fields.hint: A fictional supplier, used only in this exercise.

lessons.result: Example Books is the selected training vendor. Purchasing and receiving are separate stages.
lessons.warning: This exercise does not place an order or commit funds. Budget, tax and currency settings need local review.

lessons.title: Add a subscription
lessons.overview: A serial subscription connects a bibliographic record with a publication schedule and receiving workflow.
steps: Choose the correct record and vendor for the subscription.
Review Library, item creation and notes on the first form.
Continue to the publication pattern and dates, checking the prediction before saving.

fields.label: Record
fields.hint: Synthetic journal title.

fields.label: Library
fields.hint: Example library code.

lessons.result: The example subscription information is ready for the next form. Receiving issues is a later operation.
lessons.warning: Frequency, numbering and irregular issues require careful setup. This simulator does not predict real issue dates.

lessons.title: Inventory
lessons.overview: Inventory compares a physical shelf check with item records. Options can affect loans and last-seen information.
steps: Choose the collection or item range to inventory.
Prepare a barcode file or enter one barcode per line and review the checkin options.
Inspect the comparison results before accepting updates or acting on missing items.

fields.label: Barcode list (one barcode per line)
fields.hint: One synthetic scanned copy in this exercise.

lessons.result: DEMO-2001 appears in the training inventory. An item absent from a scan is not automatically proven lost.
lessons.warning: Review “Do not check in items scanned during inventory”. Real inventory options can change circulation state.

lessons.title: Stage MARC records
lessons.overview: MARC staging prepares an import batch for review; staging and committing the batch are different steps.
steps: Select the file and confirm Record type, Character encoding and Format.
Review the matching rule and actions for matching and unmatched records, including item processing.
Stage the file, then inspect the batch and matches before committing an import.

fields.label: Training file name
fields.hint: A name only. No file is uploaded.

fields.label: Record type
fields.hint: Training batch type.

lessons.result: A synthetic bibliographic batch is staged for review. Nothing has been committed to a catalog.
lessons.warning: Test a small batch and make a verified backup before a real import. Incorrect matching actions can overwrite existing records.

lessons.title: Create a list
lessons.overview: Lists collect bibliographic records for a purpose without creating duplicate catalog records.
steps: Open Lists and create or select a list.
Enter its name and review visibility and who may change its contents.
Add the intended records and verify the resulting list.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: A fictional list used for training.

lessons.result: The example list is ready for bibliographic records. List membership does not change item ownership.
lessons.warning: Public visibility and editing permissions are separate decisions; review both before saving a real list.

lessons.title: System preferences
lessons.overview: System preferences affect library-wide behavior and should be changed deliberately.
steps: Open Administration and System preferences with an authorized account.
Search for the specific preference and read its explanation and current value.
Record the original setting, review the effect and save only the intended change.

fields.label: Training preference search
fields.hint: Search only; this exercise does not change the search engine.

lessons.result: The example preference is located for inspection. No preference value has been changed.
lessons.warning: Some settings need additional setup or reindexing. Do not switch engines simply to complete a tutorial.

lessons.title: Administration overview
lessons.overview: Administration groups configuration such as libraries, patron categories, item types and circulation rules.
steps: Identify the configuration area relevant to your task.
Review existing codes and dependencies before creating or editing settings.
Test the effect on a representative patron and item before applying broad changes.

fields.label: Training configuration area
fields.hint: Start by inspecting existing libraries.

lessons.result: The Libraries area is selected for review. Configuration codes connect many records and rules.
lessons.warning: Deleting or renaming referenced codes can have broad effects. This exercise does not reproduce all administrative forms.

lessons.title: Tools overview
lessons.overview: Tools contains specialized and batch operations. The available tools depend on permissions and configuration.
steps: Choose a tool based on the operation, not only the name of the file you received.
Read the tool options and identify whether it can modify or delete records.
For batch changes, test a small selection and review the result before a larger operation.

fields.label: Training tool
fields.hint: Open the Inventory lesson for a guided example.

lessons.result: Inventory is the selected training tool. MARC staging has its own separate lesson.
lessons.warning: A preview is not always a completed operation. Verify the outcome and retain a recovery path for destructive tools.

lessons.title: Course reserves
lessons.overview: Course reserves associates course information with teaching resources when the feature is enabled.
steps: Open Course reserves and check that departments are configured.
Enter the course details and review instructors and visibility.
Save the course, then review the separate workflow for adding reserve items.

fields.label: Course name
fields.hint: Fictional course.

fields.label: Course number
fields.hint: Training identifier.

lessons.result: The synthetic course is ready to review. Course creation and adding reserve items are separate tasks.
lessons.warning: The module may be disabled. Required authorized values, permissions and item handling depend on local setup.

lessons.title: Interlibrary loans
lessons.overview: Interlibrary loan requests use the installed provider and its workflow.
steps: Open the requests list and inspect the patron, resource and request status.
Review supplier details, costs and staff notes before confirming an action.
Follow the provider workflow and record the outcome rather than assuming an item has arrived.

fields.label: Patron ID
fields.hint: Synthetic patron reference for training.

fields.label: Staff notes
fields.hint: Do not send this example to a supplier.

lessons.result: The example request is ready for staff review. No request, email or charge was sent.
lessons.warning: ILL providers define different fields and transitions. This exercise covers inspection, not every provider operation.
